Vertical smartphone selfie talking-head video of the same owner-authorized adult man at home. Use the IMAGE as the exact identity and appearance reference: transparent glasses, same hair, stubble, natural skin, muted olive casual overshirt open over an off-white T-shirt. Keep the home room, window and sheer curtain on image-left, shelves on image-right, soft daylight and close front-camera framing. Phone held just above eye level at arm's length outside frame. Gentle existing handheld character, steady supporting arm, consistent shoulders and camera distance.

He is casually thinking aloud to a familiar viewer in an unplanned talk. Small, responsive expressions with relaxed attentive moments between them. Warm live eyes, ordinary irregular blinking, tiny brow and cheek responses. Keep lips and jaw free to articulate every syllable clearly. Follow the supplied AUDIO exactly for words, consonants, cadence, pitch, pace, pauses and onset. No added words, laugh, filler, sound, music or ambience. Finish the final word fully. The GTM Engine explanation is deliberately more measured; follow the supplied slower delivery without rushing ahead.

Performance timing relative to the supplied audio: begin relaxed and attentive. At 3.85 seconds a small self-aware asymmetric smirk starts in anticipation of “I’ve gotta get better at that.” Let it peak around 4.40 seconds during the admission, with slight cheek lift and eye-corner warmth. It should soften and fully settle by 5.25 seconds, BEFORE “With AI” begins at 5.64 seconds. Carry warmth through eyes and cheeks without clamping or stretching the speaking lips. Deliver “With AI” with a settled mouth, near-frontal head and direct engaged gaze; stay close to the lens throughout that sentence. Do not look away while starting “With AI.” After “help me work through that,” allow one very brief reflective glance beside the lens in its pause, returning before “It looks at the code.” Explain the remaining steps with small thought-related eye and brow changes and no promotional grin. End present near the lens after “already,” not saying goodbye.

Keep this restrained: no fixed grin, large toothy smile, repeated brow lifting, automatic nods, restless eye-darting, large head turn or repeated scheduled reactions. This is a recorded selfie talk with no phone-call interface. Preserve identity, glasses, wardrobe, lighting and screen direction. No subtitles, overlays, B-roll, zooms, cuts or scene changes.

EXACT SPOKEN PASSAGE (the supplied audio is the timing authority):
It’s hard to leave an app alone when it looks like something you could sell.

I’ve gotta get better at that. With AI, I can get something looking pretty good before I’ve worked out why anyone would actually use it.

So I’m building this GTM Engine to help me work through that. It looks at the code, then researches who might use it and what they’re doing already.
